info.description: pocketRag is a cost-optimized personal knowledge base that combines local vector stores with LLMs.
info.what1: Indexes local documents into a ChromaDB vector database.
info.what2: Enables semantic search across your own data.
info.what3: Uses Azure OpenAI for precise answers with citations.

labels.appSubtitle: Cost-optimized Personal AI Knowledge Base with Local ChromaDB RAG
labels.dragDropHint: PDF, TXT, MD, or DOCX up to 10 MB
labels.noDocs: No documents indexed yet. Upload a document to build your knowledge base.
labels.queryPlaceholder: Ask a question about your uploaded documents...
labels.emptyChat: Upload a document, then ask a question grounded in its content.
labels.clearConfirm: Permanently delete all documents and their vectors?
labels.errorRateLimit: The request limit was reached. Please wait and retry.
labels.errorTooLarge: The file exceeds the configured size limit.
labels.errorInvalid: The request or file is invalid.
labels.errorUnavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.
labels.errorOffline: Could not reach pocketRag. Check your connection.
labels.privacyNotice: Files and extracted chunks are stored on this private server until you delete them. Questions and retrieved excerpts are sent to Azure OpenAI only when generation is enabled.
labels.accessDescription: Enter the server access key. It is kept only in this browser tab.
labels.invalidAccess: The access key is invalid or the server is unavailable.
labels.exampleDisclaimer: Fictional documents for demonstration. They contain no real personal data and must not be used as contracts.
